scope: Preserve canonical ACAD APPID flags while retaining atomic refusal for unsupported non-flag metadata.
regression: The initial flag-refusal guard at 507ae368 caused Linux and Windows FreeCAD release qualification and fast/native jobs to fail on generated DWG handoffs. The AC1021 source inspection found ACAD flags=64, with empty application/XDATA/reactor metadata.
change: Backpatch the fixed-width canonical APPID group 70 after the callback, using a scoped per-thread sink and the existing bounded group-70 writer. Conflicting duplicate values refuse. Non-flag metadata that the prewritten row cannot retain still refuses. No public data member or virtual function was added.
checks: Canonical flags 0, 16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96 and 112 round-trip for AC1009, AC1014 and AC1032 ASCII/Binary.
Nested distinct writers retain independent flags; conflicting callbacks preserve the destination and a corrected same-writer retry passes.
Seven non-flag metadata/reference states refuse without mutating caller or destination; same-writer retry and default APPID readback pass.
Generated AC1021, AC1024 and AC1032 DWG -> ASCII/Binary DXF conversions pass 6/6 with ACAD flag 64 on readback.
The FreeCAD CLI compatibility check passes and now verifies flag 64 after conversion and DXF retry.

Local macOS FreeCAD generated AC1021 LINE open/insert and AC1021/AC1024/AC1032 primitive open/insert controls pass 8/8. Sandboxed FreeCAD launches failed because Qt reported ARM NEON unavailable; the same controls passed with desktop access.
The focused CLI contract passed when run directly; its 25-second CTest wrapper timed out locally both inside and outside the sandbox.
The APPID allocation, LTYPE allocation and source-table identity CTests passed 3/3.

The frozen implementation digest was refreshed from a clean temporary index matching all 5988 staged tracked entries; digest validation and its self-test pass. Claim statuses and receipt references are unchanged.
limitations: The failed hosted revision is not qualified; the corrected revision must rerun fast, native and FreeCAD hosted jobs.
Non-flag canonical APPID metadata is not preserved and is refused.
Generated controls do not promote independent semantic or broad format support claims.
The digest refresh does not promote support claims or turn pending native qualification into a pass.

peerAcceptance.result: All six conversions and JSON readbacks returned success and contained one ACAD APPID with is_xref_ref=1. Each conversion emitted two Unknown HEADER.DIMLDRBLK STANDARD warnings. Converter and reader share the LibreDWG implementation.
peerAcceptance.negativeControl: A scratch ASCII derivative changed only ACAD group 70 from 64 to 0; it also returned is_xref_ref=1, so the observed field cannot distinguish the flag values and does not independently verify preservation.
peerAcceptance.scope: Peer acceptance of generated outputs only; neither whole-drawing compatibility nor independent flag semantics is established. No sample files were committed.

independentDxfReader.inputs: The same six hash-bound locally generated DXF outputs listed under peerAcceptance, from AC1021/AC1024/AC1032 DWG sources in ASCII and binary encodings.
independentDxfReader.result: All six independently read ACAD flags=64; a scratch ASCII control derived from AC1021 with only group 70 changed to 0 independently read flags=0.
independentDxfReader.scope: Independent decoder observation of the emitted field for these generated files only; no native interpretation, complete drawing behavior, or support claim is established.
